# Query parameters inside procedures
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/parameterized-queries
#
# Each script creates the dataset unverified_procedures and procedures of its own. The dataset
# stays in the project after the scripts run. The emulator rejects query parameters in procedure
# bodies until these settle.

# Whether a procedure reads a query parameter of the request that calls it.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE unverified_procedures.read_parameter() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE)
BEGIN SELECT @p; END;
CALL unverified_procedures.read_parameter()
param> {"name": "p", "parameterType": {"type": "INT64"}, "parameterValue": {"value": "1"}}
?> error: Query error: Query parameter is not allowed in the body of procedure 'unverified_procedures.read_parameter': @p at [3:14]

# Whether a procedure that names no parameter runs when the request that calls it has some.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE unverified_procedures.ignore_parameter() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE)
BEGIN SELECT 1; END;
CALL unverified_procedures.ignore_parameter()
param> {"name": "p", "parameterType": {"type": "INT64"}, "parameterValue": {"value": "1"}}
?> "1"
